en:
No, it wasn't just student council members
that could have opened that lab door...

Hmmm? What was it you said earlier about 
Kiyo opening the door, Shuichi?

Unless you're a student council member, you
can't enter Angie's lab, riiiight?

I was referring to Kiyo. He couldn't
have done it...but you could have.

Because I saw you open the classroom
lock by <CLT=cltSTRONG>picking<CLT=cltNORMAL> it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi pulled out some thin needles,
and stuck them into the keyhole of the lock.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...click...*
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...*clack*
There, open says me.
Ohhh, that happened? I totally forgot.

...So you're going to pretend you don't
remember, huh?

Ah-haha, quit glaring at me like that.
Of course I remember.
Yeah, I did it.
I killed Angie.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Hm.

W-Wait, what!?
What did you just say!?

I picked the lock to her lab, snuck into the 
room, and then—WAM!—killed Angie.
The culprit was me all along.
Wh-What!?

What are you saying? 
Is this some kind of joke?

Nahhh, no joke! I thought that if I 
confessed, I could atone for my sins.

And it helped! I feel soooo much
better! Pheeeww!
Wait...so Kokichi really is culprit?
No, he's lying... I think? Maybe?
...He's lying. I'm certain of it.
Non non! Definitely not a lie. I killed Angie.

Shouldn't you guys believe the culprit
when they confess?

Then let me ask you, "culprit"...
How did you lock the room?

Huh? I-It's the same as opening it.
You pick the door closed from the outsi—
No, that doesn't make sense.

Huh? What doesn't make sense?
Can't you lock a door by picking it?

Maybe, but that's not how the culprit
locked the room.
They used a <CLT=cltSTRONG>different method<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
What different method?

Yeah, Mumbles! Use your big boy voice
and explain yourself.

U-Uh, there were two doors to the
classroom, and the one locked last was...
The front door
It was the front door.

He could've used a pick to lock the
front door!

Any other genius theories you wanna
share with us, Mumbles?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The back door
Both doors
Both doors, at the same time.

Filling two keyholes at once...
Why, that's an advanced technique!

Not bad, Mumbles!
Didn't know you had it in you!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Hey, Mumbles! If you wanna satisfy me, you
gotta use your *whole* mouth!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The door the culprit locked last
to seal the room was...

...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>back door<CLT=cltNORMAL>. That's how they made
this a locked-room mystery.

The back door had a <CLT=cltSTRONG>sliding lock<CLT=cltNORMAL>, yes?
How was it locked from the outside?

The culprit used
a <CLT=cltSTRONG>certain tool<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

<CLT=cltMIND>The tool that the culprit used to
lock the sliding lock from outside was...
